topic: AI tool tutorial: 1Password for Agents lets AI sign in for you without seeing your password
post:
Your AI agent needs to log in somewhere. Should it know your password? 🔐
1Password just launched a way to say no. Here's how it works.

1Password for Agents lets supported AI agents sign in to your accounts without ever receiving the password.

How it works 👇
1️⃣ Your AI agent reaches a sign-in page
2️⃣ It identifies itself to 1Password with a digital key and asks for that login
3️⃣ You get the request on your own device and approve or deny it
4️⃣ 1Password fills in the password or one-time code itself, so the agent never handles it

Good to know ✅
🗝️ It doesn't open your whole vault. You choose which login an agent can use, and you can disconnect it later
⚠️ Once it's signed in, the agent may still be able to read or act inside that account
💳 It's included in 1Password's Individual and Family plans

Why it matters:
AI agents are starting to do real work across our apps. Keeping your passwords out of the AI's hands is a smart default. 🛡️

Practical takeaway:
Before you let any AI agent into an account, ask two questions: does it see my password, and what can it do once it's in? 🔍

Would you let an AI agent log in for you? 👇
